prior_use: These fields were final tests for older methods. They are not in the cold_v4 forest fit or route-CQR calibration. This registration is for cold_v4 deep-noise development/calibration/final evaluation only.
source_template_rule: Existing strict Gaia cold dwarf anchor with high-quality grzW1W2 photometry; exclude externally identified members and require unique Gaia source. No role shares source identity or sky area.
target_environment_rule: All grz_base PSF rows within the role's field and target observed r bin, without WISE detection or quality preselection; target masks and formal variances are borrowed from the selected row.

policy_development.role: compare six routing policies and choose one before calibration

interval_calibration.role: one simulated observation per source and depth for split-CQR

independent_final.role: score frozen policy and calibration on distinct source/sky identities

note: The original 223-source cold_v4 shared-noise experiment remains a frozen, separate test; it is not used to select a routing policy or calibrate the new intervals.
